defaultServer.description: Name of the server used for compare, upload and download.

uploadOnSave.description: Upload files to the default server when they are saved.

password.description: Not recommended. Leave empty to be prompted; the password is then kept in VS Code's secret storage.

auth.description: Authentication method. With "key", the key file is looked up per computer (saved in VS Code on each machine), then privateKeyPath, then ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_ecdsa, id_rsa.

privateKeyPath.description: Optional fallback path to a private key, e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519. The server form keeps the path per computer instead, so it is not synced with the project.

passphrase.description: Passphrase of the private key. Leave empty to be prompted.

agent.description: true to use the SSH agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK, or the Windows OpenSSH agent pipe), or an explicit socket path / 'pageant'.

remotePath.description: Absolute remote directory mapped to the local root.

localPath.description: Local directory, relative to the workspace folder, mapped to remotePath.

ignore.description: Extra ignore patterns (gitignore syntax) for this server only.
